class.name: NetwColumnRef
class.brief_description: A column index together with the [NetwSchema] it belongs to.
class.description:
Configuration calls such as [method NetwPropertyConfig.persisted] take a reference so they can check the column belongs to the right schema. Create one with [method NetwSchema.column_ref]. [codeblock] class_name PlayerSave extends RefCounted
static var schema := NetwSchema.create(&"players").replicated(false) static var gold := schema.column_ref(schema.i64(&"gold")) static var position := schema.column_ref(schema.vector2(&"position")) [/codeblock] Code that runs every tick, such as [method NetwTableHandle.write_column], keeps using the [int] index.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Whether [member schema] has a column at [member index].

members.member: The column's index in [member schema], as returned by the method that declared it.
The column's name, or empty when [method is_valid] is [code]false[/code].
The schema this column belongs to.
